corrections.finding: The GStreamer E1 worker initially used src/frankenstein2/retina_capture_broker.py as the F2 capture baseline. Subsequent E2 evidence establishes src/frankenstein2/perception_capture_broker.py as the accepted WP709 mutation authority and retina_capture_broker.py as a parallel donor/duplicate-source lane. Therefore external GStreamer observations remain valid, but F2-baseline claims tied specifically to retina_capture_broker.py are down-scoped to donor evidence and must not drive canonical mutation directly.

Older bootstrap wording that forbids VPS/self-hosted testing is superseded. Current owner authority explicitly permits and expects clay-direct-dev and the established VPS bridge under FREE_ONLY; FREE_ONLY still forbids paid/unknown-cost external providers and Together remains forbidden.

current_perception_frontier.finding: Canonical WP709 CaptureBroker already has one-owner/source-generation lease semantics, bounded max_frames_per_source, max_frame_age_ns, bounded read windows, per-frame SHA-256/payload size/provenance, exact evicted_frame_count, missed-window signaling, RAM-only state and no world/effect/completion authority. It evicts oldest frames when age or capacity bounds are exceeded.

WP710 native scheduler source has arrived with bounded deterministic scheduling, coalescing, pressure shedding, dispatch-time permission revalidation and worker budgeting. A later Trigger-6 E1 independently consumed GStreamer plus asyncio/ZeroMQ/AnyIO references and concluded that native structural distillation is preferable to importing a heavyweight scheduler.

The strongest current backpressure risk is not basic queue boundedness. The WP710 E1 reports that coalescing equivalence does not bind required_freshness_ns, expires_monotonic_ns, cycle_id or permission_snapshot_sha256, so a later/looser request may supersede a stricter still-valid sensing obligation. A dedicated E2 coalescing-dominance objective is already claimed at commit 00d126965f4c09974fd200e20058558f583241d4; do not duplicate it.

Capture authenticated-history E2 rejects importing Merkle/BLAKE3/GStreamer solely for broker history/queue semantics. It retains the canonical WP709 authority, treats the duplicate rolling-hash broker as donor-only, and recommends stronger cumulative history commitment only if an explicit audit/recovery requirement justifies it.

WP702 remains open at producer-lineage scope despite prior bounded component evidence: current supervisor state records a direct-constructor laundering counterexample. A separate E2 producer-lineage architecture mapping is already claimed; do not create another mutation authority.

architecture_delta.decision: KEEP_CANONICAL_WP709_AND_NATIVE_WP710; REJECT HEAVYWEIGHT QUEUE/SCHEDULER IMPORT; MAKE SEMANTIC_DOMINANCE_THE REQUIRED COALESCING INVARIANT BEFORE LATEST-WINS PROMOTION
details: Keep canonical perception_capture_broker.py as sole WP709 mutation authority and reconcile/retire duplicate retina_capture_broker.py after salvaging unique tests/mechanisms.
Do not add GStreamer, ZeroMQ, AnyIO or a Merkle library merely to obtain queue/coalescing/history semantics already expressible in small deterministic F2-native code.

Treat latest-wins/drop-oldest as safe only when the retained request semantically dominates the discarded request, or construct a merged request preserving the strictest freshness, expiry and permission constraints.

Expose only decision-useful pressure telemetry; do not add fields that are derivable and unused. Candidate useful metrics are offered/enqueued, dispatched, dropped/coalesced, current queue depth and age/freshness pressure.
Preserve WP709 age bounds and missed-window evidence so intentional scheduler throttling cannot masquerade stale perception as current observation.
architecture_delta.expected_benefit: Lower stale-frame compute waste and stronger epistemic correctness without a heavyweight runtime dependency or competing capture authority.
architecture_delta.token_resource_effect: Expected neutral-to-positive: deterministic native gating/coalescing should reduce redundant perception/model work; exact savings require WP710 ablation/runtime measurement.
architecture_delta.reason_no_credit: The decisive coalescing-dominance falsifier/mapping is already owned by another Trigger-6 objective and has not yet reached an accepted executable F2 ablation/build result in this fusion.

hypothesis: The Perception Fabric's immediate correctness/performance bottleneck is semantic coalescing dominance under dynamic scheduling, not lack of a richer queue framework.
counterhypothesis: If an upstream invariant proves every newer same-key ObserveIntent strictly subsumes older freshness/expiry/permission requirements, current coalescing is already safe and additional merge logic would be unnecessary.
cheapest_discriminator: Consume the already-claimed WP710 coalescing-dominance E2 result and its executable two-intent falsifier; require a case where same-key intents differ only in stricter freshness/expiry/permission constraints and verify the stricter obligation cannot be silently discarded.
next_exact_actions: Consume rather than duplicate the active WP710 coalescing-dominance E2/falsifier result.
Reconcile canonical WP709 against duplicate retina_capture_broker.py and salvage only unique bounded-history tests/mechanisms that survive authority review.
Keep WP702 producer-lineage contradiction open until the sole mutation authority closes the direct-constructor counterexample with exact successor CI.
When a Trigger-4 result exercises WP710/WP709 on clay-direct-dev, require exact source/runtime/result receipts before any target-runtime promotion.
